mapper.sql: id, message_id, business_type, business_key, queue_name, exchange_name, routing_key, payload, exception_type, exception_message, status, retry_count, max_retry_count, last_retry_at, resolved_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dead_letter_message ( message_id, business_type, business_key, queue_name, exchange_name, routing_key, payload, exception_type, exception_message, status, retry_count, max_retry_count, last_retry_at, resolved_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{messageId}, #{businessType}, #{businessKey}, #{queueName}, #{exchangeName}, #{routingKey}, #{payload}, #{exceptionType}, #{exceptionMessage}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{maxRetryCount}, #{lastRetryAt}, #{resolvedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE dead_letter_message SET status = 'RETRIED', retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_retry_at = #{lastRetryAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND retry_count < max_retry_count
UPDATE dead_letter_message SET status = 'IGNORED', resolved_at = #{resolvedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED')
UPDATE dead_letter_message SET status = 'RESOLVED', resolved_at = #{resolvedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED', 'RETRIED')

UPDATE dead_letter_message SET status = 'FAILED', exception_message = #{exceptionMessage}, retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_retry_at = #{lastRetryAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED')
